published_title: BHBM  My way or the Highway
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Psyokid''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]] list on DeckTech in April 2001.

starting.card: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place

description: This is the Bring Him deck Ive been playing for a while its been 14-2 through Enduro and 2 other tournys.
cards: Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place
posted: Jabba the Hutt(should be mighty)
posted: Put all Sections on Alert x2
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting(8): Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place, Death Star II: Throne Room, Your Destiny, Insignificant Rebellion, Prepared Defenses, Oppressive Enforcement, Imperial Arrest Order and Mobilization Points; all counted in the 60 (total 60).
Oppressive Enforcement is a starting Effect in 2001 (Special Edition), not a Defensive Shield.

Posted 'D Dbay' dested Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark) (the strategy calls it the 'D* dbay'); 'D2 Dbay' dested Death Star II: Docking Bay; 'Endor Dbay' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay) (Dark); 'Rendilli' dested Rendili.
Posted 'Jabba the Hutt(should be mighty)' is kept as Jabba The Hutt as listed; the poster's aside suggests Mighty Jabba instead.
Posted 'Projective' dested Projective Telepathy (missing from the machine draft; restored so the Interrupts section is 14 as posted).

Posted 'Masterful' dested Masterful Move (Special Edition); the Masterful Move & Endor Occupation combo is from Reflections III, after this post. 'Barrier' dested Imperial Barrier; 'Circle' dested The Circle Is Now Complete; 'Twillik' dested Twi'lek Advisor; 'Sniper/Dark Strike' dested the Reflections II combo Sniper & Dark Strike.

Posted 'Hell to pay' dested There'll Be Hell To Pay; 'Bossk in Bus' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Dreadnut' dested Dreadnaught-Class Heavy Cruiser; 'Vaders Stick' and 'Mara Stick' dested Vader's Lightsaber and Mara Jade's Lightsaber.
The description says the deck went 14-2 through 'Enduro' and two other unnamed tournaments; no named event or finish is given, so it stays a general list.
The strategy's EDIT suggests swapping the Death Star docking bay and both Put All Sections On Alert for a Cloud City docking bay, Masterful Move and Monnok; the list is kept as posted.
